# AICode - AI Coding Agent for Legacy Enterprise Software
> https://ai-code.ai

AICode is a spec-driven AI coding assistant for VS Code, built specifically 
for maintaining large legacy enterprise codebases. It enforces a mandatory 
specification and human approval workflow before any code touches disk.

## Product
- Name: AICode
- Version: 1.8.0
- License: Freemium
- Developer: Joël Abenhaïm, AI Sovereign Labs SAS (Paris, France)
- Contact: joel@aisovereignlabs.ai

## Key facts
- 700,000 lines of TypeScript maintained using AICode itself (dogfooding)
- Offline-first: full codebase index stored locally, no data sent to intermediaries
- BYOK: developer connects directly to OpenAI or private Azure tenant
- Workflow: Ideate → Specify → Refine → Code → Verify
- 5D codebase index: lexical, vector, AST, project map, Git history

## Pricing
- Free: individual developers, organizations under 10 employees
- Pro: €30,000/year per tier of 50 users
